items.title: Fighting the design vs. absorbing via a seam, round by round
items.description: Models this unit's own two postures across successive requirement rounds. "Fighting" keeps stacking if-statements onto one function — each new rule's cost grows with how many prior rules it has to be reasoned about alongside (the round-2 coupon bug happened for exactly this reason). "Absorbing" keeps rounds identical up through the round the seam is introduced (a one-time setup cost, paid once), then flattens out — each further round is just one new PricingRule appended. Defaults (3 rounds, seam introduced at round 2) reproduce the unit's own numbers: both postures cost the same through round 1, absorbing costs slightly more at round 2 (the seam's one-time price), then pulls ahead by round 3 and the gap widens every round after.

params.name: interactionPenalty
params.label: Interaction cost per prior rule (fighting only)

items.compute: const n = params.numberOfRounds; const penalty = params.interactionPenalty; const seamRound = params.seamIntroducedAtRound; const perRound = 2; const seamSetup = 5; let fighting = 0; let absorbing = 0; for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) { fighting += perRound + penalty * (i - 1); if (i < seamRound) { absorbing += perRound + penalty * (i - 1); } else if (i === seamRound) { absorbing += seamSetup; } else { absorbing += perRound; } } return { fightingCost: Math.round(fighting * 10) / 10, absorbingCost: Math.round(absorbing * 10) / 10 };
